//: Rules deliberately off, with the reason. Everything else is on and must stay clean: this runs on every commit via lefthook.
//only-export-components: shadcn ships buttonVariants beside Button, and this repo keeps NAV_GROUP_ROUTES beside the nav that consumes it. The rule guards react-refresh granularity; splitting files to satisfy it costs more than the refresh it buys.
//no-fetch-in-effect: Deliberate, and documented at dashboard-data.tsx: this is a prerendered SPA whose shell is built with the API offline, so auth cannot come from a router loader without baking a logged-out state into the one static file served for every route.
//no-multi-component-file: A route file with its own two small subcomponents is easier to read than three files. Revisit if one grows a third.
//prefer-useReducer: The settings form's useStates are independent fields, not one transition. A reducer would add ceremony without removing a bug.
